visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a white T-shirt and black shorts walks down a narrow street toward a restaurant with a tiled exterior and a white shutter. He gestures to the camera with his hand and enters the doorway. (2) The shot shifts to a corner view of the restaurant exterior titled 'Mount 77' as a woman in a black shirt enters. (3) Inside, the camera pans across a counter where people are eating, showing a display case filled with golden-brown egg tarts and various buns. (4) Close-up shots of a steaming bowl of noodles with a fried egg and ham are shown as the man sits at a table, lifting the noodles with a fork and giving a thumbs up. (5) Transition to another bowl of dry noodles topped with an egg; the man eats heartily, looking directly into the camera while sitting in the brightly lit cafe. (6) Behind the counter, an older silver-haired man in a brown shirt prepares food in a small, well-equipped kitchen while an older woman in an apron works nearby. (7) A pineapple bun with a thick slice of butter is served on a small plate; the man picks it up, takes a large bite, and claps his hands in satisfaction. (8) A single egg tart is presented in a close-up; the man eats it in three distinct bites, nodding and smiling. (9) The video concludes with a split-screen montage and a Google Maps interface showing the restaurant's location and reviews.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic male narration starts over a bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar track (approx 115 BPM). The voice is high-arousal and friendly. (2) Narration continues describing the bakery items; low-level kitchen clinking sounds (metal on ceramic) are audible in the mix. (3) A subtle transition whoosh marks the shift to the dining segment. The speaker's pitch rises when describing the soup noodles. (4) Slurping sounds are heard as the man eats noodles, layered under the continuous narration and guitar BGM. (5) In the kitchen segment, the BGM remains steady while muffled sounds of water splashing and pans moving on the stove are heard. (6) A distinct percussive slapping sound occurs as the man claps his hands in delight after eating the bun. (7) Final segment features a quick-paced countdown for the egg tart bites, with the voice becoming increasingly enthusiastic. The BGM fades out with a final strum.
